'''Lord Finndal''' is an [[Andor]]an noble. He is married.
==History==
He was present at a banquet attended by [[Rodel Ituralde]] while [[Thom]] was still court bard in [[Caemlyn]]. Thom flirted with his wife, [[Lady Finndal]], at the end of one of his juggling tricks.
